title: Oddkin Figma components snapshot v1
description: design/figma/components.json: a read-only export of the component sets and standalone components on the exported pages of a Figma file (design/figma/components.export.js). Tests read this file and never call Figma. Families are sorted by page (export order), then name, then id; layers by path; field values by value. Each family records its node id, component properties, variants with their property values, and, per layer path (layer names below the variant root; a repeated sibling name gets " [n]"), the variables and styles it binds, the values it does not bind (literals), and the component properties it references. A nested instance is listed under `instances` with its source family, count, source variants and overridden fields. Source-owned layers stay with the source family; authored slot contents are descended into and recorded with their containing slot path. Variable paths are `<collection name>/<variable name>`, the same strings design/figma/variables.json uses, so the two files join on them; colours are lower-case hex; numbers are Figma's stored values (px).

fileName.description: figma.root.name as the Plugin API reports it (the document node, not the file's title).

source.description: The tool, session, and API calls used for the export.

frame.description: Name of the page's top-level frame that contains the family.

variants.description: Sorted by name. A standalone component is its own single variant (no `values`). Layer and value `variants` are indexes into this array.

defaultValue.description: For INSTANCE_SWAP, the source family name (and variant) of the default component. SLOT uses an empty string sentinel; its actual default content is recorded in layers and instances.

path.description: Layer names from the variant root (empty for the root itself).

in.description: Variant indexes that have this layer; absent when every variant has it.

bound.description: Bound variables (Figma field names: fills, strokes, effects, itemSpacing, paddingLeft, topLeftRadius, strokeTopWeight, fontSize, …) and styles (fillStyle, strokeStyle, effectStyle, textStyle: style names).

literals.description: Values not bound to a variable or style: fills and strokes (hex with alpha, or the paint type), strokeWeight, cornerRadius or single corners, itemSpacing, counterAxisSpacing, padding sides (non-zero, auto layout only), effects (`TYPE x y radius spread #color`), opacity below 1, and text fontSize, fontName, lineHeight, letterSpacing when no text style applies.

properties.description: Component property references (characters, visible, mainComponent → property name).

additionalProperties.description: A bare value is used by every variant that has the layer; otherwise the value lists its variant indexes.

source.description: Family name of the instance's main component.

sourceId.description: Node id of that family (component set or component).
